indexes.name: idx_oracle_canonical_market_snapshot_market_seq
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_oracle_canonical_market_snapshot_market_seq ON public.oracle_canonical_observations USING btree (COALESCE(NULLIF((COALESCE(((canonical_observation_json -> 'raw_observation'::text) -> 'payload'::text), (canonical_observation_json -> 'payload'::text), '{}'::jsonb) ->> 'source_market_id'::text), ''::text), NULLIF((COALESCE(((canonical_observation_json -> 'raw_observation'::text) -> 'payload'::text), (canonical_observation_json -> 'payload'::text), '{}'::jsonb) ->> 'market_id'::text), ''::text), NULLIF((COALESCE(((canonical_observation_json -> 'raw_observation'::text) -> 'payload'::text), (canonical_observation_json -> 'payload'::text), '{}'::jsonb) ->> 'source_symbol'::text), ''::text)), sequence_number DESC) WHERE (observation_type = 'market_snapshot'::text)
